info.name: HTP Boiler Parts API
info.description: Single-file API for HTP boilers including Phoenix Plus PHP199-119 to PHP399-119 with model-specific control boards from LP-454
info.hosting: Upload this ONE file to any static website (GitHub Pages, Azure Blob, S3, Netlify) and it becomes your API. No server code needed.

endpoints_how_to_use_when_hosted.usage: Fetch the whole file once, then filter in your bot/app. This is how a static API works.
endpoints_how_to_use_when_hosted.example_python: import requests, json; api = requests.get('https://your-site.com/api.json').json(); model = [m for f in api['catalog'] for m in f['models'] if 'PHP399-119' in m['modelName']][0]; print(model['parts'])
guided_bot_flow: Filter api.catalog by application, fuel, family
open_bot_flow: Search across all parts: [p for f in api.catalog for m in f.models for p in m.parts if '7100P-1111' in p.part]
